title: Leaf Man
author: Lois Ehlert

hero.name: Leaf Man
hero.description: A figure made entirely of autumn leaves arranged in the shape of a man, as seen on the book cover
hero.source_note: Named character made of collaged leaves — generic Boardmaker won't match; source from Creative Fabrica, TPT, or create custom collage image

notes: Leaf Man is a wordless-style collage book with minimal text; vocabulary supports describing the journey of the Leaf Man blown by the wind across an autumn landscape. 'Fall' and 'autumn' are included because the season is visually and thematically central — consider using whichever term the classroom uses. 'Orange' is the dominant colour throughout the book and is worth including as a fringe colour word. Several words (leaf, acorn, pumpkin) already exist in activity_images and can be reused. The existing aac_extras 'fly' and 'blow' are both highly relevant and should be surfaced in the board context even though they sit in core-adjacent slots.
